ancestries/android.json.name: Android
facts: Visible circuitry can glow; do not assume exposed robot machinery.

ancestries/vesk.json.name: Vesk
facts: Muscular, scaled humanoid with a strong tail, claws, and teeth.
Bony head and jaw projections; scale colors can vary.

ancestries/kasatha.json.name: Kasatha
facts: Four arms on a tall humanoid body.
Gray skin, black eyes, and a skull elongated toward the back.

ancestries/barathu.json.name: Barathu
facts: Floating, inflated body with hanging tentacles or limbs, rather than a standard humanoid silhouette.
Body form and coloration are variable.

ancestries/human.json.name: Human
facts: Human anatomy with individually varied skin, hair, facial features, and build.

classes/envoy.json.name: Envoy
classes/envoy.json.summary: A coordination and social expertise role; no required uniform or equipment.

classes/mystic.json.name: Mystic
classes/mystic.json.summary: A magical role associated with connections; appearance and equipment remain individual.

classes/operative.json.name: Operative
classes/operative.json.summary: A precision and specialist expertise role; do not prescribe a specific weapon or outfit.

classes/solarian.json.name: Solarian
classes/solarian.json.summary: A cosmic-energy martial role; show manifestations only when the subject calls for them.

classes/soldier.json.name: Soldier
classes/soldier.json.summary: An area-fire and defensive combat role; do not invent mandatory armor or a weapon loadout.

classes/witchwarper.json.name: Witchwarper
classes/witchwarper.json.summary: A reality-altering magical role; do not invent required physical mutations.
